forms.name: automation_notify
forms.description: Notify the owner: a card they can accept or dismiss, a push and an email. Call it only when the owner needs to act on this change; otherwise end without it and nothing reaches them. At most once per turn.

title.description: One line, at most 80 characters, leading with what the owner would act on.

summary.description: What happened and why it matters, at most 100 words.

actions.description: What accepting the card will do: one or two of these, never anything else. project: work on the site or the app (change a page, build a screen); text says what will be done, and Len does it when the owner accepts. reply: an email to a person whose address you read in this turn, sent exactly as written when the owner accepts.

body.description: reply: the whole message, as it will be sent.

actions.description: What accepting the card will do: one or two of these, never anything else. project: work on the site or the app (change a page, build a screen); text says what will be done, and Len does it when the owner accepts. data_change: change ONE row of the table reservas that you read in this turn — key is the value of its key, set the columns and their new values (columns you may change: mesa, hora). The owner applies it; you never write the data. reply: an email to a person whose address you read in this turn, sent exactly as written when the owner accepts.

key.description: data_change: the value of the row's key.

set.description: data_change: each column to change and its new value.

body.description: reply: the whole message, as it will be sent.
